procedural_success: All selected, expanded occurrences have valid observations, required state/resource lineage, and verified closeout. An ended attempt is insufficient.
scientific_metrics: paired white/black difference with session and uncertainty
heater V*I divided by measured emitter area during valid last-120-second plateau interval
GTI minus DNI only when sun-normal, synchronized and compatible
spectra with accessory/reference and specimen provenance
seven-sensor post-equilibrium averages by actual condition
forbidden_success_shortcuts: count a test fixture as a real episode
implementation_scope: Static package and symbolic planning validation only; no real acquisition adapter or observation verifier
